scene: You roll off the delivery truck into bustling Robot Repair Yard.
picture: A flat side-view yard. Far left, an open yellow delivery truck. Left, a round yellow droid juggles loose cogs. Next, the South Asian girl with a black braid in a teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair. Centre, a wooden workbench sparks with glowing wires. Right, an overflowing green parts bin sits beside scrap.
shown: a wobbly round yellow droid juggling metal cogs on the left
a wooden workbench covered in glowing tubes and sparking wires at the centre
an overflowing green bin full of shiny gears on the right
